adjudication.question: Did the Polish state or its government-in-exile formally collaborate with Nazi Germany?
adjudication.note: All editions agree there was no formal collaboration; state never surrendered and rejected German proposals.

adjudication.question: What scale of individual Polish collaboration with the occupier does the article describe?
adjudication.note: All cite ~5% (Madajczyk estimate) as marginal collaboration; ar adds broader range (7,000-hundreds of thousands) as context but consistent with same 5% figure.

adjudication.question: What role does the article attribute to Poles in the deaths of Jews under occupation?
adjudication.note: All three describe it as structural collaboration via indifference, not direct perpetration, consistently attributing killings to Nazi Germany.
